panels.title: 00 - 核心驾驶舱 / Core Cockpit
交易入口状态 / Trading Readiness
panels.description: 10 秒内先看这里：Broker、登录会话、行情 WebSocket、Gateway reachable 是否具备交易基础条件。

panels.title: 监控池与订阅 / Universe and Subscriptions
panels.description: 这里展示数量，不是利用率：pool 是行情监控池，trade watchlist 是交易扫描池，context ws 是 SPY/QQQ/VIX 等固定上下文订阅。

panels.title: 行情新鲜度 / Market Data Freshness
panels.description: 行情消息与 5m bar pipeline 的延迟；超过 60s 关注，超过 180s 视为严重滞后。

panels.title: 信号、账户与订单核心健康 / Signal, Account and Order Health
panels.description: 只放可行动异常：信号需关注个数、账户数据熔断、account_pnl 超时、订单失败、非良性 IB 错误、状态接口超时次数（近 5 分钟）。

panels.title: 当前信号多空 / Current Active Signals
panels.description: 实时有效信号多空数；只统计当前交易日非终态 ibkr_signals，closed/expired/rejected/cancelled 不计入。

panels.title: 当前订单 / Current Open Orders
panels.description: Gateway live_open_orders 快照；open legs 是订单腿，open groups 优先使用 live_order_groups，缺失时按 parent/trade group 聚合。

panels.title: 当前持仓 / Current Positions
panels.description: Gateway positions 当前非零持仓数；flat 行不计入 total。

panels.title: 可用金额 / Available Capital
panels.description: 交易可用金额主看 Remaining Buying Power；低于 warn_floor 变黄，低于 block_floor 变红。AvailableFunds 和 Cash 仅作对照。

targets.expr: ((max by (source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})) < on(source) (max by (source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_warn_floor_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"}))) and on(source) ((max by (source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})) >= on(source) (max by (source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_block_floor_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})))

panels.title: 当前异常摘要 / Active Issues
panels.description: 最近 5 分钟只展示真实异常；benign、empty、正常轮询下沉到诊断区。

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", severity!="benign"}[5m])) > 0

sum by (service, target_service, route, exception_class) (increase(ibkr_http_client_exceptions_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", route=~"/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez", exception_class=~"ReadTimeout|Timeout"}[5m])) > 0
sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!~"ok|synced|seen"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: 服务采集与版本 / Scrape and Version Health
panels.description: Prometheus 是否能抓到 IBKR 与监控组件；同时展示 ibapi/Gateway 版本标记。

targets.expr: max by (service, environment, component, version, status) (ibkr_component_version_info{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", component=~"ibapi|gateway"})

panels.title: 主机核心资源 / Host Core Resource
panels.description: CPU、内存和关键文件系统剩余百分比。

panels.title: 00A - 交易运行开关 / Trading Runtime Switches
关键开关关闭数 / Disabled Required Switches
panels.description: 只统计会影响自动交易、行情写入、调度与保护链路的 critical/guard 开关；正常应为 0。

targets.expr: sum(1 - max by (environment, runtime_environment, key, mode_scope, importance) (ibkr_runtime_config_switch_enabled{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", importance=~"critical|guard"}))
sum(1 - max by (environment, runtime_environment, key, mode_scope, importance) (ibkr_runtime_config_switch_enabled{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", importance="critical"}))
sum(1 - max by (environment, runtime_environment, key, mode_scope, importance) (ibkr_runtime_config_switch_enabled{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", importance="guard"}))

panels.title: 交易入口开关 / Trading Entry Switches
panels.description: 开仓/信号入站相关的核心开关；PAPER 环境不把 live 二次开关计入 required 关闭数。

panels.title: 行情与调度开关 / Market and Scheduler Switches
panels.description: compute / scheduler / bars / WebSocket 四个行情与扫描总控，任何一个关闭都会造成信号链路缺数据或不执行。

panels.title: 执行保护/可选开关 / Guards and Optional Switches
panels.description: 展示下单串行、IB 问题抑制与 Order Flow 等辅助开关；可选开关关闭不直接判定为故障。

panels.title: 关闭的关键/保护开关 / Disabled Critical and Guard Switches
panels.description: 只列出 critical/guard 且当前为 OFF 的开关；用于快速判断是自锁开关导致，还是 Gateway/账户链路问题。

targets.expr: (1 - max by (environment, runtime_environment, key, mode_scope, importance) (ibkr_runtime_config_switch_enabled{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", importance=~"critical|guard"})) > 0

panels.title: 全部交易运行开关明细 / All Trading Runtime Switches
panels.description: 按 config environment、runtime environment、scope、importance、key 展示 0/1；key 是固定白名单，避免高基数标签。

targets.expr: max by (environment, runtime_environment, key, mode_scope, importance) (ibkr_runtime_config_switch_enabled{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: 01 - 行情与订阅 / Market Data Details
监控池数量 / Universe Symbol Counts
panels.description: context ws 是固定上下文行情，不代表完整监控池；完整监控池看 pool/trade watchlist。

panels.title: 订阅容量 / Subscription Capacity
panels.description: context ws 是固定上下文行情订阅；完整监控池看左侧 Universe。

panels.title: 订阅利用率 / Subscription Utilization
panels.description: 容量利用率只看 total/trade/websocket；不再把 context ws 的 3/3 显示成 monitor 100%。

panels.title: 行情延迟趋势 / Market Freshness Trend
Bar Pending Symbols / Bar Pending Symbols
02 - Gateway 与 IB API / Gateway and IB API
Gateway 状态 / Gateway State
panels.description: 合并 Gateway reachable、登录会话、行情 WS、Broker ready、socket listening，避免分散重复。

panels.title: IB API 普通请求 p95 / IB API Normal Request p95
panels.description: 普通 IB 请求延迟，不含 account_pnl；用于判断 Gateway 是否整体变慢。

panels.title: 账户 PnL 请求 / Account PnL Request
panels.description: account_pnl 高通常是 IB reqPnL 回调超时，不代表 Gateway 全局变慢；timeout 次数同图展示。

panels.title: IB API 请求 QPS / IB API Request QPS
IB 非良性错误 / Non-Benign IB Errors
panels.description: 主错误面板只看 severity!=benign；2100/2104/2107/2158 等良性消息在诊断区。

targets.expr: sum by (client_role, ib_error_code, request_kind, severity) (rate(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", severity!="benign"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: IB API Pending 请求 / IB API Pending Requests
03 - 信号链路 / Signal Pipeline
信号核心个数 / Signal Core Counts
panels.description: 近 5 分钟信号处理个数，加上近 24 小时真实业务信号创建数；正常 empty 轮询下沉诊断。

panels.title: 信号阶段个数趋势 / Signal Stage Count Trend
panels.description: 按 5 分钟滚动窗口展示信号阶段事件个数；过滤 empty 轮询避免误读。

panels.title: 信号阶段 p95 延迟 / Signal Stage p95 Latency
信号需关注个数趋势 / Signal Attention Count Trend
panels.description: 按 5 分钟滚动窗口展示 rejected、blocked、deferred、unauthenticated、error 等需关注信号事件个数。

panels.title: 信号处理明细 / Signal Processing Diagnostics
panels.description: 当前 dashboard 时间范围内的信号事件累计个数；例如 reverse_poll reverse ok empty 表示反向轮询正常但无待处理项。

targets.expr: sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_signal_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 每日真实信号趋势 / Daily Signal Record Trend
panels.description: 最近 30 天按滚动 1 天窗口统计 ibkr_signals 新创建的真实业务信号；从指标上线后开始累计，不回填历史记录。

panels.title: 真实信号来源明细 / Signal Record Source Breakdown
panels.description: 最近 30 天按来源、方向、初始状态聚合真实业务信号创建数；不包含更新、重复、合并或抑制的 follow-up。

panels.title: 04 - 订单链路 / Order Pipeline
真实订单命令 QPS / Real Order Command QPS
panels.description: 只展示真实下单、改价、撤单、保护单操作；不含 tracker 轮询。

panels.title: 订单失败 / Order Failures
panels.description: 只显示 result 非 ok/synced/seen 的可行动失败。

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!~"ok|synced|seen"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: 真实订单操作 p95 / Real Order Operation p95
panels.description: 真实订单操作延迟；tracker 轮询延迟单独放右下诊断。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_order_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|place_bracket_order|place_market_close|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_all_orders|cancel_entry|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify_order|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 真实订单命令累计 / Real Order Command Counts
panels.description: 这里才是下单/改价/撤单类命令累计；tracker_live_orders_fetch 不再放入订单命令。

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|place_bracket_order|place_market_close|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_all_orders|cancel_entry|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify_order|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 订单追踪轮询 / Order Tracker Polling
panels.description: 轮询/同步不是下单数量；empty 表示正常但无待处理订单。

targets.legendFormat: 订单追踪：拉取 open orders {{result}} {{reason_code}}
订单追踪：定时/强制轮询 {{result}} {{reason_code}}

panels.title: 订单追踪 p95 / Order Tracker p95
panels.description: tracker 正常毫秒级；偶发尖刺用于诊断，不作为真实下单慢的结论。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_order_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"tracker_update|tracker_poll|tracker_live_orders_fetch|execution_fill|pb_order_sync"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 05 - HTTP 与依赖 / HTTP and Dependencies
业务 HTTP 错误 / Business HTTP Errors
panels.description: 真实业务 HTTP 错误；健康检查和状态接口单独拆出去。

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route, exception_class) (rate(ibkr_http_client_exceptions_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 状态接口超时 / Status Endpoint Timeouts
panels.description: /ibkr/status ReadTimeout 是服务间状态接口读取超时；修复后用于确认是否仍有状态构建慢、回环或依赖阻塞。

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route, exception_class) (rate(ibkr_http_client_exceptions_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", route=~"/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez", exception_class=~"ReadTimeout|Timeout"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: HTTP p95 延迟 / HTTP p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, target_service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 入口 QPS / Inbound Request QPS
出站 QPS / Outbound Request QPS

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route, outcome) (rate(ibkr_http_client_requests_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", route!~"/health|/status|/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 06 - 账户、历史与主机 / Account History and Host
账户资金 / Account Capital
panels.description: 账户资金概览；Remaining Buying Power 低于 warn_floor 变黄，低于 block_floor 变红。

targets.expr: (max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})) >= on(environment, source) (max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_warn_floor_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"}))

((max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})) < on(environment, source) (max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_warn_floor_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"}))) and on(environment, source) ((max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})) >= on(environment, source) (max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_block_floor_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})))

(max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_remaining_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"})) < on(environment, source) (max by (environment, source) (ibkr_account_buying_power_block_floor_usd{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", source=~"account_snapshot|account_summary"}))

panels.title: 保证金与敞口 / Margin and Exposure
主机资源 / Host Resource
账户资金趋势 / Account Capital Trend
历史数据与回补 / History and Backfill
99 - 诊断明细 / Diagnostics
良性 IB 消息 / Benign IB Messages
panels.description: 例如 2100 benign 通常是账户数据订阅取消/切换；不放主错误趋势。

targets.expr: sum by (client_role, ib_error_code, request_kind, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", severity="benign"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 空轮询与后台任务 / Empty Polling and Background Jobs
panels.description: empty 表示正常后台轮询但没有待处理项，用于排障，不作为业务结果。

targets.expr: sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_signal_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", reason_code="empty"}[$__range]))
sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", reason_code="empty"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Gateway Probe p95 / Gateway Probe p95
panels.description: Gateway socket 探测延迟，保留在诊断区，避免与 Gateway 状态重复。

panels.title: 状态接口影响规模 / Status Endpoint Impact
panels.description: 状态页/监控拉取超时的最近 5m 影响规模，和业务 HTTP 错误分开。

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route, exception_class) (increase(ibkr_http_client_exceptions_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", route=~"/ibkr/status|/api/custom/ibkr/statusz|/api/custom/system/summaryz|/api/custom/system/monitorz|/api/custom/system/storagez"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: 最近 5m 真实错误影响 / Real Error Impact 5m
panels.description: 只统计真实错误影响；benign 和 empty 已下沉到诊断明细。

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", severity!="benign"}[5m])) > 0
sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!~"ok|synced|seen"}[5m])) > 0

panels.title: 12 - Gateway 订单串行队列 / Gateway Order Serial Queue
Gateway 串行队列等待 p95 / Gateway Serial Queue Wait p95
panels.description: IB Gateway 下单/改单/撤单串行 gate 的排队等待 p95；持续升高表示订单突发或锁竞争。

panels.title: Gateway 串行队列超时 / Gateway Serial Queue Timeouts
panels.description: 选定时间范围内等待 Gateway order serial gate 超时的次数；任何非 0 都需要排查。

panels.title: 13 - 信号到订单流转 / Signal-to-Order Flow
流转漏斗 30d / Flow Funnel 30d
panels.description: 近 30 天从业务信号、校验、需关注事件、成功开仓到当前活跃状态的总览。

panels.title: 每日信号 vs 成功开仓 / Daily Signals vs Successful Entries
panels.description: 最近 30 天滚动 1 天业务信号数与成功/已接受开仓命令对比；保护单、平仓和 tracker 轮询不计入开仓。

panels.title: 所有信号变化 / All Signal Changes
panels.description: 最近 30 天所有非 empty 信号阶段事件变化，用于观察信号处理链路整体运转。

panels.title: 所有真实订单变化 / All Real Order Changes
panels.description: 最近 30 天真实订单命令按 operation/result 的滚动 1 天变化；不包含 tracker 轮询。

panels.title: 信号流转明细 30d / Signal Flow Diagnostics 30d
panels.description: 最近 30 天信号阶段、来源、结果与原因码聚合明细，用于定位信号为何没有进入开仓。

targets.expr: sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_signal_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", reason_code!="empty"}[30d]))

panels.title: 订单流转明细 30d / Order Flow Diagnostics 30d
panels.description: 最近 30 天真实订单命令聚合明细，配合每日趋势查看开仓、保护单、改单、撤单的变化。

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|place_bracket_order|place_market_close|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_all_orders|cancel_entry|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify_order|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel"}[30d]))

title: 量化监控 - 分阶段请求链路 / Quant Monitoring - Phased Request Flow
